facts.fact: Apply online on the UDID portal swavlambancard.gov.in ('Apply For UDID' / 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card')
facts.quote: Apply For UDID Steps to Get Your UDID Card and Disability Certificate
facts.note: The homepage's Related Links still carry 'Apply for Disability Certificate & UDID Card' in the rendered HTML, but that block is not in the checker's text copy.

facts.fact: On the homepage, click 'Apply Now'; 'Track Your Application' is there too
facts.quote: UNIQUE DISABILITY ID (UDID) APPLY NOWTRACK YOUR APPLICATION
NOW YOU CAN DOWNLOAD UDID APP

facts.fact: Help with applying is also given through application counters and registration camps run by District Welfare Officers
facts.quote: District Welfare Officers: These officers assist PwDs by managing application counters and facilitating registration camps.

facts.fact: CMO offices and Medical Boards process the applications: they verify, assess and issue the certificate and UDID card
facts.quote: Medical Authorities: CMO Offices and Medical Boards use the portal to process applications, verify details, perform assessments and issue Disability Certificates and UDID cards electronically.

facts.fact: Aadhaar is mandatory for applying for a UDID card (2023 notification for adults)
facts.quote: Notification for making Aadhaar number mandatory for applying for UDID card for Adult.

facts.fact: Step 1: submit the application on the portal
facts.quote: Double-check all details and submit the application through the Portal.

facts.fact: Step 2: when the status shows 'Submitted', visit the UDID/disability certification section of the hospital chosen in the application
facts.quote: When it shows Submitted Mode visit the concerned UDID/Disability Certification Section at the Hospital that has been chosen at the time of submission of application.

facts.fact: Step 3: the hospital/medical authority verifies the application
facts.quote: Get your application verified by the concerned Hospital or Medical Authority or make corrections if required for verification.

facts.fact: Step 4: specialist doctor(s) assess the disability
facts.quote: After verification, the concerned medical authority will assign specialist doctor(s) to assess your disability.

facts.fact: Step 5: the Medical Board reviews the report and fixes the type and percentage of disability
facts.quote: They will determine the type and percentage of your disability and validate the disability certificate.

facts.fact: Step 6: the medical authority generates the disability certificate and UDID card
facts.quote: Based on the Medical Boards assessment, the concerned medical authority will generate your UDID card and disability certificate.

facts.fact: DEPwD dispatches the UDID card to the registered address by Speed Post
facts.quote: will dispatch the card to your registered address via Speed Post.

facts.fact: Application status can be tracked on the portal
facts.quote: they can apply for a Disability Certificate and UDID card, track application status

facts.fact: No minimum disability percentage is needed for a disability certificate / UDID card: the RPwD Act sets no 40% condition
facts.quote: The RPwD Act, 2016 does not impose any condition for issuance of disability certificates/UDID cards to PwDs who are diagnosed with below 40% of disability.

facts.fact: DEPwD (letter of 05-07-2024) asked States to direct hospitals not to deny certificates/UDID cards to persons assessed below 40%
facts.quote: issue directions to all notified authorities/Hospitals not to deny disability certificates/UDID cards to Persons who are diagnosed with below 40% of disability.

facts.fact: Benchmark disability (40% or more) is needed for benefits such as reservation under the RPwD Act
facts.quote: Section 34 of the said Act provides for 4 % reservation in the government employment to the persons with benchmark (40% or above) disabilities.

summary: All UDID facts confirmed: 6-step process on swavlambancard.gov.in, Aadhaar mandatory, no 40% minimum for the card (DEPwD 05-07-2024), benchmark 40% for reservation (PIB).
